channel.description: Find the right tool at the right price.

item.title: KOSIN BBQ Grill Light for $12 at Amazon
item.description: This is a super-bright LED grill light designed for outdoor barbecues. The deal offers the light at $12, making it a budget-friendly accessory for grilling at night.

item.title: Home Depot Traverse Portable Charcoal Grill in Red for $49.97
item.description: The Home Depot Traverse Portable Charcoal Grill in red is available for $49.97 with free shipping to store or home. This portable grill is suitable for outdoor cooking on the go.

item.title: Bosch 12V Max Brushless Grinder Bare Tool for $69.99
item.description: The Bosch 12V Max Brushless Grinder is a compact, bare tool designed for professionals needing quick cuts in tight spaces. This deal offers the grinder at $69.99, a significant discount from its regular price.

item.title: ThermoMaven Digital Meat Thermometer Drops to $7
item.description: The ThermoMaven Professional Digital Meat Thermometer (HT04) is available for $6.99 after applying a promo code at checkout. This digital thermometer provides quick and accurate temperature readings for meat. Shipping is free with Amazon Prime or on orders over $35.

item.title: Midea Flexify Pro 26.4 qt. Air Fryer Toaster Oven $129.99 at Costco
item.description: The Midea Flexify Pro is a 26.4-quart French door air fryer toaster oven featuring graphene technology. Costco offers it at $129.99, reflecting a $40 manufacturer's savings valid from August 31 through September 13, 2026, while supplies last.

item.title: TempPro TempSwift Meat Thermometer Drops to $8.98
item.description: The TempPro TempSwift is a digital meat thermometer designed for grilling, BBQ, and baking, featuring a push-button probe release for easy use. This deal brings the price down to $8.98, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Expert Grill Barbecue Spatula for 97 Cents with Free Shipping
item.description: This stainless steel barbecue spatula from Expert Grill features a 15-inch length and a detachable handle for easy storage. Walmart is offering it for 97 cents with free shipping for Walmart+ members.

item.title: BLUEY Bubble Lawn Mower for Toddlers at $13.98 on Amazon
item.description: The BLUEY Bubble Lawn Mower is a toy for toddlers that produces bubbles while being pushed. It is currently available at Amazon for $13.98 with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Hyper Tough 3-Drawer Rolling Tool Cabinet for $49 at Walmart
item.description: This rolling tool cabinet from Hyper Tough features three drawers for organizing hand tools. It is currently available for $49 with free shipping from Walmart.

item.title: Refurbished eufy Video Doorbell C31 with 2K FHD for $43.99
item.description: The eufy Video Doorbell Camera C31 is a smart doorbell that provides 2K FHD security video and two-way intercom, with no monthly fees. This refurbished unit is available from the Anker Outlet Store on eBay for $43.99 with free shipping.

item.title: ECO-WORTHY 10W Solar Charger 2-Pack Drops to $32
item.description: This 2-pack of ECO-WORTHY 10W solar battery chargers is designed to maintain 12V batteries in vehicles, boats, and outdoor equipment. The set is available for $31.99 with promo code LABORDAY20 at checkout, and shipping is free.

item.title: Craftsman V20 Jig Saw with 4Ah Battery and Charger for $99
item.description: Ace Hardware offers the Craftsman V20 cordless jig saw (brushed model CMCS600B) bundled with a 4Ah battery and charger for $99. This kit provides a complete solution for cutting wood and other materials without needing a separate battery purchase.

item.title: Pit Boss Grill Cleaner Drops to $8.99 at Amazon
item.description: Amazon is offering the 18-ounce Pit Boss Foaming Grill & Smoker Cleaner Degreaser for $8.99. Free shipping is available with Prime or on orders over $35.

item.title: Lowe's Labor Day Sale: Leaf Blowers Up to 60% Off
item.description: Lowe's Labor Day sale includes discounts on battery, gas, and backpack leaf blowers from brands like Toro, EGO, Greenworks, and Kobalt. Deals start at $79, with savings up to 60% off.

item.title: Ryobi ONE+ Tools Discounted at Home Depot, Up to 69% Off
item.description: Home Depot is offering discounts on a range of Ryobi ONE+ tools, including saws, sanders, nailers, batteries, outdoor tools, and cleanup gear. Prices start at $49.97, with savings up to 69% off.

item.title: Heat Resistant Grill Gloves with Long Sleeves for $14.99
item.description: These gloves are designed for grilling, baking, and other high-heat tasks, withstanding temperatures up to 932°F. They feature a waterproof, oil-resistant neoprene coating and long sleeves for added protection. The deal price is $14.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Alpha Grillers Instant Read Meat Thermometer Drops to $12.31
item.description: The Alpha Grillers Instant Read Meat Thermometer provides quick and accurate temperature readings for cooking, grilling, and food preparation. This deal offers the thermometer at $12.31 with free shipping for Amazon Prime members.

item.title: SPACECARE Power Tool Organizer with Charging Station for $20.13
item.description: This organizer holds power tools and includes a charging station. It is currently 50% off with a promo code, bringing the price to $20.13.

item.title: Odoland Folding Charcoal Grill for Camping and Backpacking at $36.39
item.description: This portable charcoal grill folds down to a compact size for easy storage and transport, making it suitable for camping, backpacking, and bonfire cooking. The deal includes free shipping, bringing the price to $36.39.

item.title: Protebox 48x30 Inch Fireproof Grill Mat for $21.84
item.description: This Protebox under grill mat measures 48 by 30 inches and is designed to protect decks and patios from heat, grease, and spills. It is double-sided, fireproof, waterproof, and oil-proof, suitable for use under grills, fire pits, and fireplaces. The deal offers the mat at $21.84.

item.title: Camp Chef 24-Inch Portable Propane Grill for $239.99 at Amazon
item.description: The Camp Chef Gridiron Gameday is a portable propane grill with 24,000 BTUs of cooking power. Amazon has it for $239.99 with free shipping.

item.title: A-MAZE-N 12-Inch Stainless Pellet Tube Smoker for $13.49
item.description: This stainless steel pellet tube smoker from A-MAZE-N is designed for both hot and cold smoking. It measures 12 inches and is currently available for $13.49.

item.title: Kamado Joe Grate Expander for Big Joe 24-inch Grills at $88.68
item.description: This stainless steel grate expander from Kamado Joe increases cooking space and enables indirect cooking on Big Joe 24-inch charcoal grills and smokers. It is currently available for $88.68.

item.title: Traeger Pro 780 Pellet Grill and Smoker with WiFIRE at $599.99
item.description: The Traeger Pro 780 is a pellet grill and smoker with WiFIRE technology, allowing remote control and monitoring via a smartphone app. This deal from Best Buy prices it at $599.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Greenworks 60V Trimmer and Blower Combo with Battery and Charger for $199.98
item.description: This combo includes a 13-inch string trimmer and a leaf blower with 140 MPH and 540 CFM, powered by a 60V system. It comes with a 4Ah battery and charger. The set is available at Best Buy for $199.98 with free shipping.

item.title: Cuisinart Grillster Portable Grill Cover for $12.30
item.description: This is a protective cover designed for the Cuisinart Grillster portable gas grill, with dimensions of 18 by 11 by 8.5 inches for a snug fit. The cover is available for $12.30, offering a practical accessory to shield the grill from the elements.

item.title: Grill Baskets from $11.99 at Woot
item.description: These heavy-duty stainless steel grill baskets come in a large size or a set with two small ones. The large basket is $11.99, and the set with two small baskets is $16.99.

item.title: Indoor Grill and Electric Griddle for $23.99 with Free Shipping
item.description: This indoor grill and electric griddle is available in beige or royal blue. The price is $23.99 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: JOFIOS Solar Post Cap Lights 12-Pack for $19.99 with Code
item.description: This 12-pack of JOFIOS solar post cap lights fits 4x4 posts and is available in black or white. The set is priced at $39.99, but a 50% coupon code brings it to $19.99 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: WORX Turbine 800-CFM Leaf Blower Drops to $49.99 at Lowe's
item.description: The WORX TURBINE 800-CFM 135-MPH corded electric leaf blower is available for $49.99 at Lowe's. This handheld blower delivers high air volume and speed for efficient yard cleanup.
